text.tspan: This interface is through the General Instruments AY-3-8910 or Yamaha YM-3439
Programmable Sound Generator (PSG) chip. It is pinned out in a DB25S. The Centronics
STROBE signal is generated from a PSG bit.
The Centronics BUSY and Printer Acknowledge signals from the printer connects to one of the
parallel input lines of the MFP to permit interrupt driven printing. Eight bits of read/write data
are handled through I/O port B on the PSG at a typical data transfer rate exceeding 4000
The parallel port uses a DB 25 pin S connector with the following pin assignments:
